projects.title: Banking Management System
projects.desc: A console-based Bank Management System developed using C++. This project is designed to manage basic banking operations through a simple and user-friendly interface. It includes features such as account creation, user login, password management, deposit, withdrawal, balance checking, fund transfer, account information management, and account deletion. The project uses Object-Oriented Programming c
projects.details:
This Bank Management System is a C++ console-based application developed using Object-Oriented Programming and File Handling. It provides a simple way to perform and manage basic banking operations.

Key features include:
• New account creation with customer details
• Secure user login and password management
• Deposit and withdrawal of money
• Checking account balance
• Money transfer between accounts
• Viewing and managing account information
• Password recovery
• Account deletion
• File-based storage and management of account data

The project demonstrates practical implementation of C++ concepts such as classes, objects, functions, conditional statements, file handling, data validation, and basic authentication.
projects.tags: C++, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), File Handling, C++ File Streams
